scope: Device-free analysis and source-replay product correction
user_decision: Operate on an ordinary Windows PC with source, fault logs and a cloud model. Hardware, emulator, signing and a full HarmonyOS toolchain are not default requirements; local replay is sufficient as a scoped verification path.
implemented: configure defaults to execution=null; --validation selects a LocalCheckConfig source protocol, mutually exclusive with the optional --application extension.
AnalysisOnlyExecutor launches nothing and cannot pass. The actual SDK prompt and task message request an unverified diagnosis/patch without waiting for runtime access.

Source checks reuse original/candidate project copies, the managed process executor, fixed independent checks and durable replay. They execute candidate code within validation_scope and mocked_interfaces.
source_execution/source authority flows through CheckResult, failed-check feedback, decisions, working context and applicability. It cannot become synthetic or full application evidence.

New source execution and analysis/source competition reports use schema 4. A source_verified competition result is accepted only at its declared source scope; application_verification stays not_run. Analysis may complete with a patch_proposed result but remains accepted=false.

The same official SDK loop, private credentials, budgets, unknown-result handling, checkpoint recovery, Skills and context mechanisms remain in place. No second execution platform or protocol SDK was introduced.
A plain Node.js example actually loads original/candidate JavaScript bytes and rejects an index-zero shortcut that removes the target fault but changes the required business result.
Current rules, blueprint, plan, design, contracts, metrics and usage instructions now reflect the no-hardware main route. Submission templates and historical reports were not rewritten.

validation.skip_reason: One legacy execution test requires symlink creation unavailable to the current Windows account.
validation.integration: Three actual Deep Agents/official AsyncOpenAI runs with MockTransport exercise strict diagnosis, editing, freezing, checking, private delivery and completed resume without additional model sends. All use the production repair_frontier/decision_frontier context configuration. Direct source and analysis produce seven simulated model calls/plans each. The additional twelve-call source run rejects a target-passing but business-breaking first candidate, delivers source-scoped obligation feedback in the actual next wire request, preserves the original failure during revision, accepts a second candidate and clears the failure only after the passing check. Source mode executes a short Python software fixture, analysis mode launches no checks. The separate Node example executes actual JavaScript. Neither proves ArkTS/HarmonyOS or real-model effectiveness.

earlier_observations.note: Before adding standalone source doctor coverage without a default private model file.

initial_failures.cause: WinError 5 replacing execution.json.new during the regression failure receipt. Exact external/file-lock cause remains unknown.
initial_failures.resolution: Unchanged rerun passed 60 with one symlink skip; no ACL, retry policy, resource limit or production behavior was changed to make it pass.

initial_failures.cause: Import ordering/formatting in newly changed files.
initial_failures.resolution: Applied the reported import formatting; subsequent Ruff passed.

initial_failures.cause: The added test reused an old inline-panel reader that unconditionally looked for messages in reference-only required groups. The mock provider stopped at call nine with provider_transport_error/model_result_unknown, correctly leaving unresolved.
initial_failures.resolution: The test now matches the actually sent assistant/tool group and reads its complete feedback bytes. Production context selection, budgets, unknown-result handling and acceptance were unchanged. The complete three-case rerun passed.

validation.evidence_location: Managed receipts and logs are under .dfx-local/artifacts/<receipt>.json and .log. Tracked tests and the JS example preserve reproducible software fixtures; no dependency on archive.

environment.runtimes: Existing project-managed Python and existing ordinary Node.js from PATH; the example refuses to rely on a Codex-bundled Node runtime.
environment.test_policy: Only synthetic tests temporarily replace the in-memory policy read and force MockTransport/allow_network=false; the on-disk real-experiment flags remain false.

remaining: Admit representative data_B .ets source loading/extraction/transpilation and explicit platform mocks plus independent replay/business/regression checks. The plain JS example is not a universal ArkTS adapter.
Configure and authorize a real cloud provider/model/key and bounded pilot; verify real tool continuation, usage and response compatibility.

Run scoped repair and fair method comparisons, aggregate with validation coverage and unknowns, then prepare actual submission materials. No source repair rate, root-cause accuracy, savings or research effectiveness is yet known.
